# Button

**Class:** `UltraCanvasButton` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasButton.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasButton.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasButton.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Push, split or icon button

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasButton> CreateButton( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& text = "");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasButton> CreateIconButton( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& iconPath, const std::string& text = "");
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasButton(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& buttonText = "");
UltraCanvasButton(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h, const std::string& buttonText = "");
UltraCanvasButton(const std::string& identifier, const std::string& buttonText);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetOnClick()` | `void SetOnClick(std::function<void()> onClick_)` | Takes a callback. |
| `onClick` | `std::function<void()> onClick` | _Click_ |
| `onPress` | `std::function<void()> onPress` | When button is pressed down |
| `onRelease` | `std::function<void()> onRelease` | When button is released |
| `onToggle` | `std::function<void(bool isPressed)> onToggle` | When button is pressed down |
| `onDoubleClick` | `std::function<void()> onDoubleClick` | A left double-click. Set, it takes the double-click instead of the second press it otherwise counts as (the first click has already pressed, clicked or toggled the button): a list row that selects on a click and renames or opens on a double-click. |
| `onSecondaryClick` | `std::function<void()> onSecondaryClick` | For secondary section click |
| `onContextMenu` | `std::function<void(int windowX, int windowY)> onContextMenu` | Right (secondary) mouse button pressed over the button; args are window-relative coordinates, suitable for popping up a context menu there. |
| `onHoverEnter` | `std::function<void()> onHoverEnter` | The pointer comes over the button / goes off it. A toggle button that is on reports it too; a push button held down does not. |
| `onHoverLeave` | `std::function<void()> onHoverLeave` | _Hover leave_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `ButtonIconPosition`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Left` | Icon on the left of text |
| `Right` | Icon on the right of text |
| `Top` | Icon above text |
| `Bottom` | Icon below text |
| `Center` | Icon only (no text displayed when Center) |

### enum `ButtonSecondaryIconPosition`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Left` | Icon on the left of secondary text |
| `Right` | Icon on the right of secondary text |

### enum `ButtonVariant`

A button's part in the window, which FromTheme maps the theme onto: Standard - the raised surface with the control border (a text button); Ghost - no fill at rest, the hover and pressed fills (an icon button in a bar); Primary - the accent fill with text on it (the one main action); Selected - a ghost button in its on state (the active tool, a toggle that is on): the soft accent fill with the accent for its ink

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Standard` |  |
| `Ghost` |  |
| `Primary` |  |
| `Selected` |  |
